<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="430" height="932" viewBox="0 0 430 932">

    <rect x="420" y="16" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <g>
    <text x="28" y="76" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, sans-serif" font-size="28.92px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">make simple</text>

    <circle cx="399" cy="58" r="4" fill="#965128"/>

  <g>
    <text x="40" y="126" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, sans-serif" font-size="24px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Choose your shade</text>
    <text x="40" y="146" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFFCC">Find a match or open one you saved</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Large rounded photographic selection panel -->
  <g>
    <rect x="40" y="160" width="350" height="547" rx="40" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
    <rect x="40" y="158" width="350" height="547" rx="40" fill="#1C1C1E"/>
    <circle cx="318" cy="228" r="75" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
    <circle cx="121" cy="511" r="112" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>

    <text x="66" y="691" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFFCC">Personalized for you</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="40" y="728" width="160" height="32" rx="40" fill="#965128" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

  <g>

  <g>
    <rect x="40" y="780" width="350" height="42" rx="40" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>

  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>

    <polygon points="66,867 76,858 86,867" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>

    <text x="344" y="897" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Big Shoulders Display, Apple SD Gothic Neo Thin, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFFCC">Account</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Home indicator -->
  <rect x="145" y="918" width="140" height="5" rx="100" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
</svg>
